issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship for invites, members modals, mail, or auth paths despite mandatory test-first policy.
Server-context ID is client-writable without #[Locked]; tampering is mitigated only by entity-scoped findOrFail.
User-input property has no #[Validate] attribute and is only checked via validateOnly in saveRole().
Mass-assignment is declared via #[Fillable] attribute instead of the $fillable/$guarded property pattern.
Invite and membership writes use Eloquent directly in Livewire components instead of app/Actions/* classes.
Invite-only domain change updates database-schema and CHANGELOG but leaves business-rules docs untouched.
Semantically identical slash-escaping churn (\/ vs /) unrelated to the task.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:51 selectedMembershipId without #[Locked]; app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:53 memberRole without #[Validate]; direct EntityInvite::create/firstOrCreate in components; docs/business-rules.md absent

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:65 sendInvite, 167 openMember, 185 saveRole, 226 confirmRemoval; app/Livewire/Entity/PendingInvites.php:96 accept/339 decline; clear names and small focused methods

requirements.evidence: database/migrations/2026_10_29_062141_create_entity_invites_table.php:571 unique entity_id+email; app/Models/EntityInvite.php:470 saving normalizes email; Members.php:74-133 member/pending/race/rate-limit handling; PendingInvites.php:302-336 email-match 403, expired error on invite, idempotent accepted, firstOrCreate + session + redirect; members.blade.php:873 exact modal title; routes/web.php:952 can:update,entity

scope.evidence: All functional hunks serve invites/members/mail except lang/pt_BR.json:646,655,665,675 \/ escaping noise

security.evidence: Members.php:60,67,151,169,187 authorize update + 196 authorize assignRole + 242 authorize delete; PendingInvites.php:302,345 abort_if email mismatch 403; Members.php:41-48 validation rules; Mail::to queue + RateLimiter 10/hour; {{ }} escaping throughout, but selectedMembershipId/confirmingRemoval lack #[Locked]

simplicity.evidence: Reuses policies, mail::message/mail::button, #[Validate], RateLimiter; delete-expired-then-create for replacement; no new service layers or abstractions

tests.evidence: change.diff has no tests/**, *Test.php, or Pest additions for new sendInvite/cancelInvite/accept/decline/modal/auth paths

review.summary: Implements invite-only membership end to end with correct pending/expiry/race/rate-limit handling, manager-only members page, modals, mail, and lang keys. Withholds approval because no tests ship despite the project TDD mandate, plus Livewire hardening gaps (unlocked server IDs, missing Validate attribute). Otherwise lean, readable, secure, and tightly scoped.
